title: VibeGuard — chat, memory and a governed improvement
capture_environment: local Modelence production build with real hosted Atlas and Agent Engine services
policy_status: proposed; human decision and approved-version rerun pending

scenes.caption: REAL CHAT · Atlas goal recall and independently verified saved turns
scenes.narration: VibeGuard combines chat, durable memory, and measured harness improvement. This real chat recalls our project goal from Atlas, and both conversation turns have independently verified records.

scenes.caption: LEARN WHILE BUILDING · Contextual explanations appear when relevant
scenes.narration: Relevant popups explain what is happening as you build. Here, a real memory rate limit triggered a proposed change.

scenes.caption: INCIDENT REPLAY · Avoidable recalls 8 → 0 · Simulated turns retained 51 → 51
scenes.narration: A live model proposed a sixty-second recall cooldown. Across seven frozen incident replay cases, avoidable recall attempts fell from eight to zero. All fifty-one simulated conversation turns remained recorded. These are replay results.

scenes.caption: HUMAN REVIEW PENDING · Opening the dialog does not activate a policy
scenes.narration: RRFlow opens the exact policy for human review. The user chooses a decision and submits it explicitly. This proposal is still pending. Activation and a rerun tied to the approved version remain next.

scenes.caption: LOCAL PRODUCTION WALKTHROUGH · Human approval and the approved-version rerun remain pending
scenes.narration: The goal is a harness that improves while preserving continuity and human control.
scenes.note: Await actual Raindrop capture and verified behavior before adding any trace claim.
